title: Self-Guided LLM Reasoning for Error Diagnosis in Vehicle Routing Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.21393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are fundamental to many real-world applications. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred progress in solving these NP-hard problems. However, most existing approaches assume that input instances are error-free, neglecting the presence of faults commonly encountered in real-world data. In this work, we systematically investigate the capability of LLMs to detect (and correct) errors in VRP instances, and identify key limitations, particularly in handling complex instances or errors that substantially increase the LLM's reasoning burden. To overcome these challenges, we propose a self-guided reasoning framework in which LLMs autonomously generate code that provides structured insights to aid in error diagnosis. Experiments across diverse problem settings and LLMs demonstrate that our framework significantly improves error detection performance, achieving near-perfect accuracy.

translated_title: 面向车辆路径问题错误诊断的自引导大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 车辆路径问题（VRPs）是许多现实应用的基础。大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展推动了解决这些NP难问题的研究进展。然而，大多数现有方法都假设输入实例是无错误的，忽略了现实世界数据中普遍存在的错误。在本工作中，我们系统地研究了LLM检测（和纠正）VRP实例中错误的能力，并识别出其关键局限性，尤其是在处理复杂实例或会显著增加LLM推理负担的错误时。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了一个自引导推理框架，在该框架中LLM自主生成代码，提供结构化见解以辅助错误诊断。在多种问题设置和不同LLM上的实验表明，我们的框架显著提升了错误检测性能，达到了接近完美的准确率。
tldr: 本文提出一种自引导推理框架，让大语言模型自主生成代码以提供结构化见解，从而辅助诊断车辆路径问题实例中的错误，将错误检测性能显著提升至接近完美准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-guided reasoning framework in which LLMs autonomously generate code to provide structured insights for error diagnosis in Vehicle Routing Problems, significantly improving error detection to near-perfect accuracy.
